findings.passage: I have always advocated for voter rights and support election reform legislation.
findings.note: Fall 2019 office newsletter (date from the file name 0919). He lists co-sponsored bills: HB 1556 automatic voter registration and HB 1493, which would let all registered voters request an absentee ballot. No mention of ID.

findings.passage: Voting by mail has numerous advantages over traditional voting, from increasing voter participation and saving taxpayer dollars to reducing the chance of fraud even more.
findings.note: Spring office newsletter (file name suggests 0519, year not stated on page text read). He describes introducing HB 1059 (ongoing mail ballots after one request) and HB 765 (paper ballots required because electronic systems are vulnerable to hacking). No mention of ID.
